verdict.rationale: LegalZoom is a SaaS platform that stores user documents and offers AI-powered features such as meeting-minutes generation, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no documented setting, policy, or commitment that keeps user data out of AI model training. The llms.txt probe only gives guidance to AI crawlers about the public website, which is an adjacent control and does not cover user data, so it earns no credit.
